notes.title: Free to play
notes.notes:
We want to thank our fans for their support and decided to make Soccer Adventures Free to Play. We have alrerady requested the change at Steam support.

Happy Gaming!

Michael

notes.title: First Public Update - 25th February 2021
notes.notes:
This is our first update so we are really excited to announce it today. ːsteamhappyː

So what's new?

1. Some improvements in the main menu and the store. 

2. In the store you find a short description about each item. 

3. Better gamepad controls. Now you can rotate the player with the right stick if you are not running. This feature was requested by many users and should help targeting a lot.  

4. Modified the jump behaviour a little bit. If you use Speed Run the player jumps slightly longer so the speed flow is not so interrupted anymore. 

4. Some minor improvements in several levels. Especially level 5 is much easier now (we think this is good news for many players ːsteammockingː)

5. Some users experienced sound problems in the main intro. We think this is fixed now and you should be able to listen to the complete title song. 

6. The damage of the Happy Present has been increased.

7. Speed Run costs 200 credits now. So you can buy Speed Run prior to level 5 even if you did not collect any special items during the first 4 levels.

Hope you really enjoy it as much as we do! More to come! 

ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: First Developer Live Stream
notes.notes:
Come in and watch the founder of [url=https://www.dotparc.com/games]dotparc Gaming Studios[/url] and developer of Soccer Adventures, Michael Welz, playing the game live on Steam Broadcast. 

Michael will also show some of the hidden achievements of the game. Thus if you are an achievement hunter, this can be really interesting to watch. 

So put on your soccer dress, lace up your soccer shoes, and do not forget your shin guards. Join Michael and Robin on his big adventure against the thieving American football team.
